categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: Includes a release note, but release notes accompanying a code change do not make it a docs category PR.
categories.rationale: A code change that updates its release notes belongs to the affected functional area rather than docs.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Carries RPC/REST/ZMQ label and gates the `iswatchonly` field in `getaddressinfo` behind `-deprecatedrpc`.
categories.rationale: This follows standard RPC deprecation discipline by hiding a defunct field that unconditionally returned false behind `-deprecatedrpc`. While deprecation discipline is important in RPC, phasing out an already static dummy field has deferrable urgency.
